12. Meta-Learning Return Loop 
Der Rückkanal Optimization -> Self-Learning bleibt verpflichtender Bestandteil des Zielbilds. Meta-Learning soll
lernen, welche Optimierungsfamilien, Search-Methoden und Evidence-Muster unter welchen Bedingungen robuste
Resultate erzeugen. 
Evidence-Typ   Quelle   Verwendung 
LEARNING_EVIDENCE   Productive Outcomes/Systembeobachtung   informiert Optimization Research
OPTIMIZATION_EXPERIMENT_EVIDENCE   Search/Experiment/Challenger/OOS/Robustness   Input für Meta-Learning
META_LEARNING_EVIDENCE   Learning über den Optimierungsprozess   priorisiert/gestaltet nächste
Research-Experimente 
META_EVIDENCE MAY: Research-Experimente priorisieren, unter autorisierten Search-Methoden wählen, bounded
Research-Budget allokieren, Hypothesen vorschlagen.
META_EVIDENCE MUST NOT: Trading-Instrumente reranken/reselecten, Master V2/Double Play ändern, Envelope
umgehen, Risk/Governance lockern, Candidate deployen.

Peak_Trade - Meta Learning & Optimization Universe - Concept v3.1 Addendum   Addendum Page 2 
20. Reale produktive Parameteroptimierung als Ziel 
Das Optimization Universe ist keine isolierte Research-Spielwiese. Sein Ziel ist, innerhalb explizit autorisierter Surfaces
Parameter zu untersuchen und zu optimieren, die im realen produktiven System einen belegten Consumer besitzen. Die
Authority-Trennung betrifft die   Freigabe , nicht die Relevanz des Parameters. 
OPTIMIZATION und PRODUCTIVE TRADING sind getrennte Authority-Domänen desselben Governed Trading Stack. Der
Optimizer darf einen besseren Candidate ermitteln; er darf diesen Candidate nicht selbst produktiv aktivieren. 
20.1 Vollständige Parameter-Lineage 
Eine Optimization Surface gilt für das produktive Ziel erst dann als end-to-end geschlossen, wenn die vollständige typisierte
Lineage bis zum realen Consumer nachgewiesen ist: 
Optimization   Surface
-> Candidate   Parameter Value
-> Search /   Challenger / OOS / Robustness / Economic / Failure Evidence
-> PROPOSAL_ONLY
-> Governance +   Risk Admission
-> Explicit   Productive Authorization
-> Governed   Productive Parameter / Configuration
-> Authorized Productive Parameter Seam
-> konkreter   CURRENT Productive Consumer 
Stufe   Authority / Regel
Optimization Surface   Nur explizit owner-autorisierte, fail-closed Domain; UNIVERSE_MEMBER !=
AUTHORIZED_OPTIMIZATION_TARGET.
Candidate + Evidence   Research/Proposal only. Ein besseres Resultat ist Evidence, noch keine produktive Konfiguration.
Governance + Risk   Prüft Evidence, Constraints, Zielbindung und Risk-Grenzen. Risk bleibt harte Ausschlussgrenze.
Explicit Productive Authorization   Bindet Candidate-Identity, Evidence-Lineage, Productive Target, Constraints und
Owner-/Authorization-Identity.
Governed Productive Configuration   Darf nur aus gültiger Authorization entstehen; kein direkter Optimization-Write.
Productive Consumer   Konsumiert den autorisierten Parameter über einen bestehenden oder explizit ratifizierten typed
Seam.
MV2 + Double-Play Trading Core   Verwendet zulässige Inputs, bleibt aber selbst alleinige Trading-Decision-Authority. 
20.2 Beispielsemantik 
Beispiel: Eine autorisierte Surface untersucht   max_age_seconds . Der Optimizer darf Candidate-Werte vergleichen und
Evidence erzeugen. Er darf nicht selbst   productive   max_age_seconds   :=   candidate   setzen. Erst nach
Governance/Risk und expliziter produktiver Authorization darf der autorisierte Wert in genau den produktiven Parameter-Seam
materialisiert werden, dessen realer Consumer nachgewiesen ist. 
DoD-Erweiterung: Ein Optimization-Ergebnis ist nicht deshalb produktiv relevant, weil es gut performt. Produktive
Relevanz erfordert eine geschlossene, auditierbare Surface->Candidate->Evidence->Authorization->Productive
Parameter->Consumer-Lineage.

15. Canonical Market Context and Realized Behavior Contracts 
The implementation target is a compositional context identity, not a monolithic feature vector with hidden ownership. Context
references preserve source identity, observation time, provenance, quality and feature-version lineage. 
15.1 MARKET_CONTEXT_V1 target shape 
MARKET_CONTEXT_V1 = { context_id, observed_at, instrument_ref, information_set_ref, price_state_ref, flow_state_ref,
liquidity_microstructure_state_ref, derivatives_state_ref, volatility_state_ref, cross_market_state_ref, quality_state_ref,
provenance_refs, feature_versions } 
Missing context families remain explicit. No silent zero-fill, forward-fill or inferred availability is permitted where the source contract
does not authorize it. 
15.2 Realized behavior target 
Behavior family   Examples   Evidence role 
Forward behavior   Forward return distribution; continuation/reversal/range.   Condition forecast and representation quality.
Excursion   MFE / MAE over explicit N_BARS horizon.   Measure path quality, not only terminal return.
Volatility / tails   Realized volatility, tail/shock behavior.   Measure uncertainty and adverse-state behavior.
Transition   State/regime transition labels where supported.   Measure conditional stability and transition risk. 
15.3 Normative temporal join 
MARKET_CONTEXT(t) -> FORECAST(t,N) -> REALIZED_BEHAVIOR(t+N) -> ERROR / CALIBRATION ->
CONDITIONED_LEARNING_EVIDENCE 
The join must preserve point-in-time information sets, finalization, explicit horizon identity, overlap control and lookahead
prevention. N_BARS remains the normative realized-outcome backbone; this extension enriches conditioning information rather
than replacing the outcome mechanism. 
15.4 Decision attribution remains subordinate 
ATTRIBUTION_EVIDENCE_V1 = { market_context_ref(t), selected_future_ref, mv2_dp_decision_ref(t), side_state_ref,
configuration_ref, realized_behavior_ref(t+N), quality_refs } 
Attribution measures under which contexts existing MV2/Double Play decisions were robust, weakly calibrated or insufficiently
supported. It is evidence only and creates no runtime gate or decision mutation.

Peak_Trade - Unified Runtime / Market Intelligence / Meta-Learning / Optimization Blueprint   Page 17 
16. Strongest Closed Intelligence Cycle - Three Learning
Functions 
The target architecture preserves Loop A and the established Optimization/Meta loop, then adds one typed Meta-to-Learning
feedback seam. Meta-Learning does not broadcast undifferentiated evidence. It classifies evidence by semantic owner and
returns it only to the stack that is allowed to use it. 
MARKET -> LEARNING -> OPTIMIZATION -> META-LEARNING -> { OPTIMIZATION | LEARNING } -> NEXT CYCLE 
16.1 Loop A - Market / Outcome Learning (preserved) 
PRODUCTIVE OBSERVATION / DECISION + MARKET_CONTEXT(t) -> REALIZED OUTCOME / SYSTEM EVIDENCE ->
SELF-LEARNING -> LEARNING EVIDENCE -> OPTIMIZATION INPUT 
Purpose: learn market behavior, forecast reliability, conditioned outcomes, calibration, coverage and drift. 
16.2 Loop B - Research / Optimization Meta Loop (preserved) 
OPTIMIZATION EXPERIMENT -> CHALLENGER / OOS / ROBUSTNESS / FAILURE EVIDENCE -> META-LEARNING ->
META_RESEARCH_EVIDENCE -> BETTER NEXT OPTIMIZATION RESEARCH / SEARCH CHOICE 
Purpose: learn which search families, surfaces, experiment structures and research choices produce robust or repeatedly rejected
evidence. 
16.3 Loop C - Representation Feedback Loop (new) 
LEARNING REPRESENTATION -> OPTIMIZATION EVIDENCE -> META-LEARNING -> META_LEARNING_EVIDENCE ->
LEARNING RESEARCH / ADAPTATION INPUT -> NEW LEARNING EVIDENCE 
Purpose: return evidence about feature usefulness, redundancy, context-family value, regime conditionality, coverage weakness,
representation drift and repeatedly failed representation hypotheses to the Learning research context. 
16.4 Core law 
META_FEEDBACK_IS_EVIDENCE_NOT_AUTHORITY=true | NO_SELF_MODIFYING_LEARNING=true |
NO_DIRECT_FEATURE_DROP=true | NO_DIRECT_PARAMETER_MUTATION=true | NO_TRADING_GATE_FROM_META=true

17. Typed Meta-Evidence Routing - No Broadcast 
The strongest closed cycle requires semantic routing. A Meta-Learning result is not sent to both stacks merely because both could
consume it. Each record declares its evidence class, intended owner, provenance and permitted use. Unknown or mixed
classifications fail closed.

parameter-space efficiency; experiment failure

usefulness; regime conditionality; coverage

17.2 Routing law 
RESEARCH_CHOICE -> OPTIMIZATION ONLY | LEARNING_REPRESENTATION -> LEARNING ONLY | UNKNOWN/MIXED -> NO
AUTOMATIC FEEDBACK 
17.3 Learning-side consumption law 
Meta-to-Learning feedback may influence only bounded research/adaptation choices that are explicitly represented in the
Learning contract. It may not silently change productive features, model weights, thresholds, trading configuration, selection, risk,
sizing or execution behavior. 
17.4 Optimization-side consumption law 
Meta-to-Optimization feedback may prioritize the next bounded experiment/search choice. It may not promote candidates, write
productive configuration, authorize a surface, select a productive future, mutate MV2/Double Play or create an external effect. 
17.5 Deterministic replay 
A complete cycle must replay: source evidence -> meta ingest -> classification -> routed meta evidence -> consumer research
choice -> next evidence generation, with stable identity and provenance.

18. Incremental Information Program and Optimization
Combination 
The expanded Learning information path and Optimization Universe are combined through the existing typed Learning Evidence
-> Optimization Input seam. Context families are not admitted because they exist; their incremental value is tested against a
preceding baseline. 
18.1 Incremental ladder 
Stage   Information set   Research question 
B0   Existing canonical Price + Flow baseline.   What is achievable from CURRENT canonical facts?
B1   B0 + admissible CURRENT Microstructure.   Does existing microstructure add stable incremental information?
B2   B1 + Derivatives State.   Do basis/OI/funding add orthogonal OOS information?
B3   B2 + Cross-Market State.   Does bounded anchor context improve conditional
behavior/calibration?
B4   B3 + Volatility Structure.   Does multi-horizon volatility/liquidity structure add robust value?
B5   B4 + true L2 Depth, optional.   Only if incremental OOS evidence justifies added runtime/data
complexity. 
18.2 Required evaluation dimensions 
Incremental information versus prior baseline; walk-forward/OOS stability; calibration; coverage/abstention; regime/state stability;
redundancy; drift sensitivity; temporal integrity; and operational cost/complexity. Failure and rejection remain evidence for
Meta-Learning. 
18.3 Microstructure rule 
MICROSTRUCTURE_REUSE_FIRST=true. Existing admissible microstructure is inventoried and reused before any new
producer is created. Proxy microstructure and true tick/L2 microstructure must never be silently conflated. 
18.4 Cross-market rule 
CROSS_MARKET_IS_CONTEXT_ONLY=true. Anchor instruments may inform context/evidence but cannot rerank, reselect or
create multi-future productive trading authority. 
18.5 Productive boundary 
Even a robust context family or optimized representation remains evidence/research output. Any productive parameter relevance
still follows the existing candidate -> evidence -> Governance/Risk -> explicit authorization -> governed parameter -> typed
CURRENT consumer lineage.

3. Track D1 - Market Intelligence 
The primary subject is market behavior, not rewriting the trading strategy. Market Intelligence should answer what is happening
now, what behaviors are plausible next, how uncertain that statement is, how well similar forecasts were calibrated historically, and
when evidence is insufficient or drifting. 
Capability   Target semantics   Authority
Market State   Trend, volatility, regime/transition, feature state, liquidity/spread where data supports
them.
Observation only
Market Behavior   Forward-return distribution, continuation/reversal/range behavior, MFE/MAE, realized
volatility, tails, transitions.
Evidence only
Probabilistic Outlook   Multi-horizon conditional distributions/probabilities, not a single deterministic price
target.
Forecast only
Uncertainty / Coverage   Support count, effective coverage, uncertainty, evidence age, insufficient-evidence
disposition.
No gating authority
Calibration   Forecast vs realized outcome, forecast error, reliability/calibration state.   Learning evidence
Drift   Distribution shift, state-performance drift, out-of-distribution evidence.   Observation/evidence 
3.1 N_BARS as realized-outcome backbone 
STATE(t) -> FORECAST(N) -> REALIZED_OUTCOME(t+N) -> ERROR/CALIBRATION -> LEARNING EVIDENCE 
N_BARS remains the normative realized-outcome horizon mechanism. Multi-horizon expansion must preserve explicit horizon
identity, PT1H semantics where ratified, finalization, overlap control and lookahead prevention. 
3.2 Abstention is a valid result 
A model must be allowed to return insufficient evidence when support is weak, calibration unhealthy, distribution shift material, or
model disagreement excessive. Prediction quality is prediction + uncertainty + calibration + coverage, not confidence alone. 
3.3 Decision Attribution is subordinate 
Existing selected-future, Bull/Bear state, SideState/transition state and configuration references may be composed into attribution
evidence to measure when Market Intelligence was useful. Ownership is referenced, not duplicated:
COMPOSE_REFERENCES_DONT_DUPLICATE_OWNERSHIP.

Peak_Trade - Unified Runtime / Market Intelligence / Meta-Learning / Optimization Blueprint   Page 5 
4. Track D2 - Learning and the two Evidence Loops 
Implementation must reuse CURRENT loop topology rather than build a parallel greenfield stack. The combined blueprint treats the
two established loops as the core learning mechanism. 
4.1 Loop A - Productive Learning / Outcome Loop 
PRODUCTIVE OBSERVATION/DECISION -> OUTCOME / SYSTEM EVIDENCE -> SELF-LEARNING -> LEARNING EVIDENCE ->
OPTIMIZATION INPUT 
This loop learns from realized market/system outcomes. In the Market-Intelligence extension, forecast state and forecast evidence
are joined with realized N_BARS outcomes to produce calibration, reliability, drift and conditioned behavior evidence. 
4.2 Loop B - Meta-Learning / Research Loop 
OPTIMIZATION EXPERIMENT -> CHALLENGER / OOS / ROBUSTNESS EVIDENCE -> META-LEARNING -> META-EVIDENCE
-> BETTER NEXT RESEARCH/SEARCH CHOICE -> ... 
This loop learns from the optimization process itself: which search families, surfaces, evidence patterns and experiment choices
tend to produce robust or repeatedly rejected results. Its output may prioritize bounded research; it does not choose trades. 
4.3 Inter-loop joins 
Edge   Required classification
Learning Evidence -> Optimization Input   Typed evidence boundary; preserve provenance and identity.
Optimization Evidence -> Meta-Learning   Experiment/search/robustness/failure evidence.
Meta-Evidence -> Optimization   Bounded next experiment/search choice only.
Optimization Result -> Productive Stack   PROPOSAL_ONLY until Governance/Risk + explicit authorization.
Market Intelligence -> Learning   Forecast/evaluation evidence; no decision authority.
Learning/Optimization -> MV2/DP   No direct mutation; only separately governed supporting input/parameter seams. 
Evidence feedback is not promotion. Research experiment selection is not trading selection.

Peak_Trade - Unified Runtime / Market Intelligence / Meta-Learning / Optimization Blueprint   Page 6 
5. Track D3 - Optimization Universe 
There is one Optimization Universe containing multiple isolated surfaces. A code path, historical experiment, or universe
membership does not itself authorize a surface. 
5.1 Surface model 
Surface / family   Unified status rule
F1 / M9 - Volatility Numeric Max-Age   Established vertical proof family; real productive consumer lineage is the reference pattern.
F2 - Fee/Slippage Cost Grid   Research candidate; materialize only under explicit surface ratification and proven consumer
relevance.
F5 - Pure-Stack Numeric Calibration   Deferred/conditional; decompose and adjudicate safety/survival numerics separately.
F3 - Strategy Hyperparameter Research   Deferred/conditional; requires authority-boundary adjudication before touching protected trading
semantics.
OLS coefficients   Diagnostic/evidence support; not an optimization surface.
Funding   Evaluation/model input; no proven optimization axis by existence alone.
Risk / Sizing   Constitutional boundary; NOT OPTIMIZABLE under this blueprint.
Legacy/unsupported search utilities   Preserve as historical/research evidence only; do not activate implicitly. 
5.2 What Optimization should optimize first 
• Features and state representations that robustly predict future market behavior out of sample.
• Forecast horizons and model families with stable calibration and coverage.
• Research parameters that have explicit bounded domains and a real or explicitly planned consumer.
• Robustness and abstention behavior before any attempt to maximize trading PnL. 
Optimization produces candidates and evidence. It does not write productive configuration, authorize itself, select
instruments, mutate MV2/DP, override Risk, or send orders.
